rows.text: This module manages multi-LLM routing and optimization for Claude Code. It exports strict environment variables to ensure compatibility with third-party backends, specifically disabling extended thinking and capping output tokens to prevent API failures. It provides four key functions: `ccfree` routes sessions through free cloud models via LiteLLM with automatic fallbacks; `cclocal` runs Claude Code entirely offline using Ollama; `ccchore` conserves expensive context limits by automatically offloading large log/file summaries to cheaper models; and `llmcheck` probes individual backends to report real-time availability, quota exhaustion, and errors without relying on fallback masking. Together, they enable flexible, cost-aware, and reliable LLM workflow management.
